tests.title: Review prompts rendered from templates are equivalent to the old ReviewSystemPrompt and ReviewPrompt
given: the prompt package is loaded via NewLoader()
a fixture ReviewInput with Root, Base, ChangedFiles, DiffStat, TestCommands, Scope and Spec
tests.when: the review phase builder renders review/review.system.md and review/review.md via the Loader
then: the system prompt is textually equivalent (modulo whitespace normalization) to the old ReviewSystemPrompt constant
the user message is textually equivalent to the old ReviewPrompt function output
tests.pseudocode:
loader := prompt.NewLoader()
in := fixtureReviewInput()
oldSystem := oldReviewSystemPrompt
oldUser := oldReviewPrompt(in)
newSystem, _ := loader.Render("review/review.system.md", buildReviewView(in))
newUser, _ := loader.Render("review/review.md", buildReviewView(in))
assert normalizeWS(newSystem) == normalizeWS(oldSystem)
assert normalizeWS(newUser) == normalizeWS(oldUser)

tests.title: NewLoader panics when a template header has an invalid kind value
given: an embedded FS containing a template file whose kind is 'invalid_kind'
tests.when: NewLoader() is called with that FS
then: the call panics
the panic message names the template and mentions the invalid kind
tests.pseudocode:
fs := testFS("bad.md", "---
name: bad
kind: invalid_kind
view: PhaseView
stable: false
max_bytes: 1000
---
Hello")
assert panics(func() { prompt.NewLoaderFrom(fs) })
assert panicMessage contains "bad.md" and "kind"

tests.title: The function map helpers produce correct output: fence, code, join, count, lines, trimSpace, firstNonEmpty
given: the prompt package is loaded via NewLoader()
tests.when: each function map helper is invoked through a test template
then: fence("LABEL", "text") produces '--- BEGIN LABEL ---\ntext\n--- END LABEL ---'
code("text") wraps in triple backticks
join(", ", ["a","b"]) produces 'a, b'
count([1,2,3]) returns 3

lines(2, "a
b
c") returns 'b
c'
trimSpace(" x ") returns 'x'
firstNonEmpty("", "a", "b") returns 'a'
tests.pseudocode:
loader := prompt.NewLoader()
assert renderTest(loader, `{{fence "LABEL" "text"}}`) == "--- BEGIN LABEL ---\ntext\n--- END LABEL ---"
assert renderTest(loader, `{{code "text"}}`) == "```\ntext\n```"
assert renderTest(loader, `{{join ", " .Items}}`, struct{Items []string}{[]string{"a","b"}}) == "a, b"
assert renderTest(loader, `{{count .Items}}`, struct{Items []int}{[]int{1,2,3}}) == "3"
assert renderTest(loader, `{{trimSpace " x "}}`) == "x"
assert renderTest(loader, `{{firstNonEmpty "" "a" "b"}}`) == "a"
